entities.summary: "Tzafon Medical Center named after Baruch Padeh" at Poriya, lit. Northern Medical Center, formerly simply Baruch Padeh Medical Center, generally known as Poriya Hospital, is a rural general hospital located just south of Tiberias, in the Galilee region of Israel. It is affiliated with the Safed-based Azrieli Medical Faculty of Bar Ilan University.
